definition: to successfully complete or reach a goal
example: Regular practice is essential to achieve fluency in a foreign language.

definition: to gain or obtain something
example: Children acquire language skills most easily at a young age.

definition: to manage or run an organization or system
example: The new system makes it easier to administrate large amounts of student data.

definition: to have an influence or effect on something
example: Air pollution can seriously affect people's respiratory health.

definition: suitable or proper for a particular situation
example: It is important to wear appropriate clothing for a job interview.

definition: a particular part or feature of a situation or idea
example: Cost is just one aspect that consumers consider before buying a product.

definition: to help someone
example: Volunteers assist elderly residents with daily errands.

definition: a class or group of things sharing similar characteristics
example: Jobs can be divided into several broad categories, such as manual and professional work.

definition: a distinct period or main division of a book, plan, or process
example: This chapter of the report discusses the economic effects of tourism.

definition: an official group given a specific task, or a payment for services rendered
example: The government set up a commission to investigate the causes of the accident.

definition: consisting of many interconnected parts; complicated
example: Climate change is a complex issue with no single solution.

definition: to calculate a number or amount, especially using a computer
example: The software can compute the total cost of a project within seconds.

definition: to reach a final decision or judgment after considering the facts
example: Researchers concluded that regular exercise improves mental health.

definition: to organize and carry out an activity
example: The university conducted a survey to measure student satisfaction.

definition: following as a result or effect of something
example: The factory closed, and the consequent job losses affected the whole town.

definition: to build or create something
example: The city plans to construct a new bridge to ease traffic congestion.

definition: to use up a resource, or to eat or drink something
example: Households are being encouraged to consume less energy during peak hours.

definition: the ability to obtain goods before payment, or recognition for an achievement
example: Many young people rely on credit to make large purchases.

definition: the customs, ideas, and social behavior of a particular society
example: Traveling abroad helps people understand different cultures.

definition: to plan and create something for a specific purpose
example: The building was designed to reduce energy consumption.

definition: clearly different or separate
example: City life and rural life offer two very distinct lifestyles.

definition: a part of something, especially one considered essential
example: Trust is a key element of any successful relationship.

definition: to consider one thing as equal to or the same as another
example: People often equate wealth with happiness, but the two are not the same.

definition: to judge or determine the value or quality of something
example: Teachers should evaluate students using a variety of methods, not just exams.

definition: a distinctive or notable attribute of something
example: A key feature of the new policy is free healthcare for children.

definition: coming at the end of a process; last
example: The final decision will be made by the board of directors.

definition: to concentrate attention or effort on something
example: Schools should focus more on practical skills than memorization.

definition: a strong effect or influence
example: Social media has had a major impact on how people communicate.

definition: to cause physical harm to someone
example: Thousands of workers are injured on construction sites every year.

definition: an organization set up for a particular purpose, especially research or education
example: She works at a research institute studying renewable energy.

definition: to put money into something in order to gain a future benefit
example: Governments should invest more in public transport.

definition: an individual object or article
example: Each item on the shopping list was carefully chosen to reduce waste.

definition: a scholarly publication issued regularly, or a personal diary
example: The study was published in a leading scientific journal.

definition: to keep something in good condition, or to continue a state or activity
example: Regular exercise helps maintain a healthy weight.

definition: usual, typical, or expected
example: It is now normal for employees to work from home part of the week.

definition: to get or acquire something
example: Applicants must obtain a visa before traveling for work.

definition: to take part in an activity
example: Students who participate in extracurricular activities often develop better social skills.

definition: to become aware of or interpret something in a particular way
example: Many people perceive city life as more stressful than rural life.

definition: good, favorable, or optimistic
example: Exercise has a positive effect on both physical and mental health.

definition: the capacity to develop or achieve something in the future
example: Investing in education helps young people reach their full potential.

definition: existing or occurring before something else
example: Sales this year were higher than in the previous year.

definition: main, most important, or first in order
example: The primary cause of the accident was driver fatigue.

definition: to buy something
example: More consumers now purchase goods online rather than in stores.

definition: a variety of things of the same general type
example: The store offers a wide range of eco-friendly products.

definition: a large area of land, often with defined boundaries or shared characteristics
example: Some regions rely heavily on tourism for their economy.

definition: to control an activity or process by means of rules
example: The government regulates the amount of pollution factories can produce.

definition: closely connected or appropriate to the matter at hand
example: Job applicants should highlight experience relevant to the position.

definition: to live in a particular place permanently or on a long-term basis
example: Many retirees choose to reside in warmer climates.

definition: a stock of something valuable, such as money, materials, or staff
example: Schools need more resources to support students with learning difficulties.

definition: to limit or control something
example: Some cities restrict car use in the center to reduce pollution.

definition: to obtain something, especially with effort, or to make something safe
example: A good education can help young people secure better job opportunities.

definition: to try to find or obtain something
example: Many graduates seek employment abroad for better career prospects.

definition: to carefully choose from a range of options
example: Employers should select candidates based on skills rather than personal connections.

definition: a place where something is located or is happening
example: The old factory site will be turned into a public park.

definition: a plan of action designed to achieve a long-term goal
example: The company adopted a new marketing strategy to attract younger customers.

definition: a method of collecting information or opinions from a number of people
example: A recent survey found that most employees prefer flexible working hours.

definition: written material, or a written message
example: Students are expected to read the assigned text before class.

definition: to move something or someone from one place, position, or owner to another
example: The company plans to transfer some operations to a cheaper location.
